entities.name: Luis Miró Quesada de la Guerra
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luis Joaquín Miró-Quesada de la Guerra (1880–1976) was a Peruvian journalist and politician in the early 20th century. He was the mayor of Lima from 1916 to 1918 and the Minister of Foreign Affairs in 1931. He was also the director and editor of the influential newspaper El Comercio.

entities.summary: Luis Joaquín Miró-Quesada de la Guerra (1880–1976) was a Peruvian journalist and politician in the early 20th century. He was the mayor of Lima from 1916 to 1918 and the Minister of Foreign Affairs in 1931. He was also the director and editor of the influential newspaper El Comercio.
